title: Lost Fishing Gear Is 10% Of Ocean Litter
hook: Fishing gear is only 10% of litter, but it keeps killing.
closing: Retrieving abandoned gear protects wildlife from plastic that keeps fishing by itself.
question: Should retrieval be mandatory?

segments.say: Fishing gear makes up 10% of ocean litter, but it keeps trapping animals after crews abandon it.
Lost fishing gear weighs 640,000 tons each year, turning working equipment into an enormous waste stream.
Fishing gear entangles 100,000 marine animals yearly, so the damage continues long after abandonment.
